summary: Organized DBA professional with over 6 years of experience supporting Oracle, SQL Server, and AWS infrastructure, strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, and a commitment to delivering quality services.
skills: High Availability (RAC, Data Guard, Golden Gate)

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Production support, installation, configuration, migration, backup, recovery, performance tuning, cloning, security, upgrades, and patches for Oracle databases.
Planned and upgraded Oracle databases from 11.2.0.4 to 12.2.0 and managed OEM 13c monitoring.
Implemented RMAN backup strategies and scheduled backups with Crontab.
Upgraded MySQL from 5.6 to 5.7 and optimized performance with mysqld_multi.
Migrated databases to AWS using Database Migration Service and maintained RDS/EC2 instances.
Created snapshots, Elastic IPs, EBS volumes, security groups, and performed cross‑region replication with S3.

experience.title: Database Administrator
responsibilities: Resolved web application issues and provided database performance tuning using EXPLAIN PLAN, TKPROF, STATSPACK, AWR, and SQL TRACE.
Managed physical, logical, and active standby databases with Data Guard and RAC for disaster recovery.
Generated ASH, ADDM, and AWR reports to analyze wait events and optimize queries.
Implemented high‑availability solutions (RAC, ASM, ACFS) and migrated databases to RAC.
Performed backup and recovery operations with RMAN, Data Pump, and logical backups.
Maintained AWS RDS/EC2 instances, snapshots, and security groups.

experience.title: Oracle Database Administrator
responsibilities: Prepared technical architecture proposals and migrated standalone databases to RAC.
Provided senior technical support, performance tuning, and high‑availability maintenance.
Managed physical, logical, and active standby databases with Data Guard.
Implemented security measures (TDE, auditing) and applied PSU/CPU patches.
Replicated data in real time using Golden Gate and managed backup strategies with RMAN and Data Pump.
